learned: 2026-10-05, by an agent pass: Spacebuds is a Veterans Choice Creations (NY licensee) line sold through VCC's Wix store, which also carries VCC's other brands; the /spacebuds category page holds 27 products (Moonrocks 4g/28g, Moon Matter 1g, Moon Rolls 1.5g, Moon Stone 1g AIO vapes). Catalog only: every price is 0.
notes: Read the Spacebuds category page only; VCC's store carries Pot & Head, New York Honey and others on other pages. The gallery shows 20 a page but loads cumulatively, and ?page=N carries the first 20*N products in its wix-warmup-data, so ?page=3 covers up to 60 (27 on 2026-10-05). If productsWithMetaData.totalCount passes 60, raise the page.

Titles are 'SIZE | LINE | FLAVOR' with uneven spacing and order ('1G | MOON STONE | LIQUID DIAMONDS | BERRY FRUIT BLAST', '1G |  LIQUID DIAMONDS MOON STONE | ...', 'MOON ROLL' beside 'MOON ROLLS'). The flavour is always the last segment; the lines are set as constants so spelling variants do not split a line. title_case turns the capitals into 'Melon Ball' (three-letter words stay as written: 'Apple PIE').

The category is the product's option key (MOONROCKS, PRE-ROLLS, CONCENTRATES, VAPE). Moonrocks are infused flower (product pages: buds drenched in hash rosin and coated in kief); Moon Matter is pressed hash, kief and terpenes; the Moon Stone vapes are all-in-ones, as their image alt text says.

The 28G Moonrocks jars are titled 'MOONROCKS' but are the 'Space Ballers' line: their product pages say 'Space Ballers have landed... These 1-ounce jars', their alt text names Space Baller, and stores list them as 'Space Ballers'. The alt text decides, so the jars get that line.
Moon Bites edibles, which a few stores sell, are not on the site (their category page is empty).
